title: A generator of a nullable or union element type panics the compiler on a `yield` of a literal.
text: `public static function g(): Iterator<?int> { yield 2; }` passes the checker, and the build then panics in `nvs-ir` ("a `yield` operand lowered to Int where the declared `Iterator<T>` gives Tagged"). So do `yield null;` in an `Iterator<?int>` or an `Iterator<?string>`, and `yield 1;` in an `Iterator<int|string>`. A `yield $x;` of a `?int` variable works. Every `yield` the checker accepts compiles and gives its value to the loop. It closes when that is so, with a conformance case for each element type.
